name: Skirmisher
description: Skirmisher excels in moving around the battlefield and acting out of turn.

features.name: Skirmisher at Arms
features.body: Gain proficiencies with 3 Martial weapons of your and in Light and Medium armour.

features.name: Skirmish
features.body:
Gain a secondary pool of **6m** of Movement that can only be used outside of your turn during a **Skirmish**. A Skirmish a pseudo-turn that you can enter by interrupting another creature’s turn, before their turn starts. You can Skirmish **1 time** per round, but this increases by **+1** at Skirmisher Levels 3, 6 and 9, and Player Levels 13 and 17. Skirmish don’t count as regular turns, so any start-of-turn or end-of-turn effects apply.

The amount of movement you can use during Skirmishes resets at the start of your turn, and increases **+4m** at Skirmisher Levels 4, 7 and 10. Any bonuses to Movement also apply Skirmish Movement. Dashing or Sprinting during a Skirmish only applies to Skirmish Movement.

features.name: Disengage
features.body: You can preform Disengage as an Extra Action.

features.name: Quick Step
features.body: The first attack Attack of Opportunity each enemy makes against you has Disadvantage. At Skirmisher Level 6 all Attacks of Opportunity against you are made with Disadvantage.

features.name: I Am Speed
features.body: You can Dash as an Extra Action. Once per turn you can Sprint as a Half Action.

features.name: Hit and Run
features.body: You gain 1 Half Action and 1 Extra Action each Round that can only be used during Skirmishes.

features.name: Acceleration
features.body: During your turn you can use a Half Action or Extra Action to add a Half Action that’s used during Skirmishes. (Remember that two Half Actions can combine into a Full Action and vice-versa)
